subject: Discovery recap & pilot activation map
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: ian.carter@nodehealth.ai, sofia@nodehealth.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap & pilot activation map

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so we have alignment before we spin up a pilot.

High-level qualification notes
- Primary use case: real-time triage assistant for clinical intake forms (short completions + rerank).
- Volume: expected ~2000 inference requests/day during pilot; peak bursts ~120 reqs/min.
- Data sensitivity: PHI pseudonymized at ingestion; retention window TBD but likely 90 days.
- Decision-maker: Ian Carter (CTO), budget owner: Sofia A. (Head of Ops).

Proposed pilot (30-day sprint) — Activation map (owner in parentheses)
1) Kickoff & test data handoff (Day 0–2) — Jasmine (Redwood) + NodeHealth eng
2) Model selection & perf baseline (Day 3–7) — Ben (inference)
3) Integration + sample traffic (Day 8–14) — Jordan (integration)
4) Success metric collection & quality eval (Day 15–25) — NodeHealth + Marissa (CS)
5) Final readout & exec decision (Day 26–30) — Jasmine + NodeHealth execs

Proposed success criteria (suggested, open to edits)
- Latency P95 < 350ms for 512-token avg requests under production-like bursts
- Throughput sustaining 100 reqs/min without SLA degradation
- Top-1 accuracy (domain-specific scoring set) >= 88% vs current baseline
- No critical security findings in onboarding checklist

Requested from NodeHealth to proceed
- Handful of representative anonymized prompts and expected outputs (csv)
- Confirmation on retention window and whether they need private deployment (VPC)
- Point-of-contact for SOC2/security questions (we usually loop in Security for questionnaires)

Attachments: initial KPI template attached (nodehealth-poc-kpis.csv) and a one-page activation map (redwood-pilot-activation-map.pdf).

If that looks good I can schedule the kickoff for next Tuesday.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Ian Carter <ian.carter@nodehealth.ai>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: sofia@nodehealth.ai, security@nodehealth.ai
Date: 2026-08-31T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & pilot activation map

Thanks Jasmine — very helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: legal wants a hard cap of 60 days for any exported inference artefacts; can you confirm what Redwood supports on retention TTLs and whether that's enforced on the control plane?
2) Private vs hosted: initial run should be hosted, but if KPI thresholds require it we'll evaluate a VPC (we need a cost delta estimate).
3) Success metric tweak: instead of Top-1 accuracy we measure weighted F1 on our adjudicated labels (we'll share the scoring script).

On the timeline — next Tuesday works for a kickoff. Can you include a short agenda (15–20 min) that covers the data handoff and the minimal integration steps?

Also cc'ing our security contact (DataSec Team) — they will send a short questionnaire this week.

Ian
CTO, NodeHealth
